notes:
Hyundai, Kia and Genesis passenger cars, with the electric, hybrid and petrol or diesel units on the one table: Kona Electric, Niro, Ioniq, Soul EV, Ioniq 5, EV6 and GV60, and the i10, i20, i30, Ceed, Sportage, Tucson and G80. Which units a given car has depends on the model and year, so a unit that stays silent is reported as no response and is not proof that the unit is absent.

The bus is 11-bit CAN at 500 kbit/s on the diagnostic socket. Every reply identifier is the request identifier plus 8. Most units take UDS service 22 with a two-byte identifier. Units marked in their description read by an eight-bit local identifier with service 21 (the Kona sheet and OVMS read the VIN from such a unit with service 1A option 80, while this tool's identification read sends option 86, so which options a unit answers is unconfirmed), so those units carry their own diagnostics block with the KWP2000 services over CAN. Two units (the motor control unit and the battery management system) use service 22 on some cars and service 21 on others: the table takes the service most of the signal sets use, and the description and source name the exception. The sources send no session request, so the default session is the one opened; whether a unit answers a session request at all is unconfirmed.

Every address is taken as a fact from the sources named in each row: OBDb signal sets (CC-BY-SA-4.0), the OVMS poll tables (MIT), opendbc (MIT) and a shared Kona PIDs sheet. No signal definition, scaling or text was copied from them, so no unit defines named values here. Treat every row as unconfirmed until `obd-read probe` shows the unit answering on the car.

Secure gateway: a tool vendor handout lists Hyundai, Kia and Genesis as fitting a secure gateway module from model year 2018, with the focus on write access and a US-oriented list. Whether reads pass the gateway on a given car is unconfirmed, so expect some of these units to stay silent.

description: Hyundai, Kia and Genesis cars (electric, hybrid and petrol or diesel), UDS and service 21 over CAN

engine.description: Engine control unit (ICE and hybrid), reads by local identifier with service 21
engine.source: OBDb signal-set repositories for Genesis-G80, Hyundai-i10, Hyundai-i20, Hyundai-i30, Hyundai-Tucson, Kia-Ceed, Kia-Niro and Kia-Sportage (header 7E0, reply 7E8, requests 2100 to 2105, CC-BY-SA-4.0, addresses taken as facts only) under https://github.com/OBDb; recorded in docs/vehicles/japan-korea.md

transmission.description: Transmission control unit, reads by local identifier with service 21
transmission.source: OBDb Genesis-G80, Hyundai-i10, Hyundai-i20, Hyundai-i30, Kia-Ceed, Kia-Niro and Kia-Sportage signal sets (header 7E1, reply 7E9, requests 21A0 and 21A1, 2201A0 on some); opendbc fingerprints.py Ecu.transmission at 0x7e1 under https://github.com/commaai/opendbc (opendbc/car/hyundai, MIT); recorded in docs/vehicles/japan-korea.md
